windows.null_rule: separate layer maxima of baseline matched-filter norms; elementwise modes repeat the sensor-SVD rotation in every null block; empirical regularization, not p-values

solver.convergence_note: Feasible primal-dual bound for the current convex MM surrogate; no global-optimality claim for log-sum.

stage1_samepoint_residual.finite_baseline_correction_note: retained in both modes for a denominator-only paired comparison; the max denominator does not preserve exact Gaussian zero-centering
stage1_samepoint_residual.identifiability_rule: positive weighted deep-gain norm and conditional_gain_fraction > eps * max(nuisance.shape), matching the nuisance SVD tolerance
stage1_samepoint_residual.modality_studentization_limit: combined-block prototype; it does not estimate independent EEG/MEG conditional nuisance spaces
stage1_samepoint_residual.nuisance_definition: column space of W G_surface (X0_surface Phi.T)
stage1_samepoint_residual.residual_sensor_dof_assumption: isotropic noise across retained weighted sensors; pooled EEG/MEG residual energy is a heuristic if whitening leaves unequal variance
stage1_samepoint_residual.residual_zero_dof_rule: fall back to plug-in baseline expectation
stage1_samepoint_residual.score: (B-3)/(B-1) * partial improvement / max(plug-in baseline expectation, post-deep residual / residual sensor dof) - 1
stage1_samepoint_residual.studentization_interpretation: empirical residual self-normalization, not a Student/F reference test; calibrate decisions on independent pure-surface cases
